title: non-ecg-core: cardiac period estimation from non-gated helical CT — sampling criteria and exploratory evaluation
description: Analysis code, frozen decision rules and complete result files for the study of what a non-gated helical chest CT can contain about cardiac timing. The repository derives the condition under which a periodically moving structure writes a recoverable period along the z axis of a helical scan, measures the number of cycles that condition requires by simulation, evaluates it against real chest CT series using DICOM headers alone, tests it on image series under a criterion frozen before the data were fitted, runs the same pipeline on the one session in a public archive that records a heart rate, and examines what a learned estimator does when the acquisition contains nothing to recover. No imaging data is redistributed here; the analysis retrieves it from The Cancer Imaging Archive by series identifier. Every number in the accompanying manuscript is resolved at build time from a result file in this repository, and every reference from its DOI.
